outreach_draft.subject: A thought on your Dealer Fraud pages
outreach_draft.body:
Craig,

I noticed LemonLaw.com has a really deep structure for Lemon Law—state-by-state and manufacturer-by-manufacturer—but Dealer Fraud, which Kimmel & Silverman says it handles, is still mostly represented through articles and resources rather than its own focused client page.

That feels like a different conversation from a defective-vehicle or warranty claim. Someone dealing with spot delivery, financing pressure, or dealership misrepresentation is arriving with different questions and needs a clearer path.

A dedicated Dealer Fraud page could:
- speak directly to that buyer’s situation
- give Google a focused page to crawl and index
- give AI tools clearer context around that part of the firm’s work

You already have useful dealer-fraud material on the site, so I’m using that as the first mockup example.

I’m putting together a quick mockup to show you what I mean. I’ll send it over in the next couple of days.

If you’d rather I didn’t, just let me know.
